justification: Adds a 'Site directory' footer link to the two consumer-surface footers (app/reports/layout.tsx — which canibuildit.com.au/ rewrites to — and app/(tools)/layout.tsx for the per-council tool pages), so the /site-directory page is reachable from the menu on canibuildit, not only the pro/marketing SiteFooter. Presentational only: one <Link> and one array entry. No data, no logic, no DB.

pre_impl.existing_data: None. /site-directory already exists and returns 200; this only links to it. The link target was verified live.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If /site-directory were removed, this footer link would 404 — but the page shipped in #828 and is live. tsc passes.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Two existing inline footers gain one link each; the marketing SiteFooter already had it (#828). No behaviour change.

break_it.scenario: The link is added to the marketing footer only (SiteFooter) again and still doesn't appear on canibuildit, because canibuildit.com.au/ rewrites to /reports which uses app/reports/layout.tsx, not SiteFooter.
break_it.what_happens: The site-directory link stays invisible on the consumer home — the exact gap being fixed.
break_it.how: Confirmed via middleware.ts (isCanibuilditDomain && pathname==='/' rewrites to /reports) that app/reports/layout.tsx is the canibuildit home footer; the link is added there and in app/(tools)/layout.tsx for the tool pages.
break_it.repro: curl canibuildit.com.au/ after deploy and grep for '/site-directory' in the footer.

post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy, open canibuildit.com.au/ and a tool page (e.g. /granny-flat/<council>) and confirm the footer shows a working 'Site directory' link.
